text.2:262: Those who spend their wealth for the cause of Allah and afterward make not reproach and injury to follow that which they have spent; their reward is with their Lord, and there shall no fear come upon them, neither shall they grieve.
text.7:175: Recite unto them the tale of him to whom We gave Our revelations, but he sloughed them off, so Satan overtook him and he became of those who lead astray.
text.10:90: And We brought the Children of Israel across the sea, and Pharaoh with his hosts pursued them in rebellion and transgression, till, when the (fate of) drowning overtook him, he exclaimed: I believe that there is no Allah save Him in Whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of those who surrender (unto Him).
text.11:60: And a curse was made to follow them in the world and on the Day of Resurrection. Lo! A'ad disbelieved in their Lord. A far removal for A'ad, the folk of Hud!
text.11:99: A curse is made to follow them in the world and on the Day of Resurrection. Hapless is the gift (that will be) given (them).
text.15:18: Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue.
text.20:78: Then Pharaoh followed them with his hosts and there covered them that which did cover them of the sea.
text.23:44: Then We sent our messengers one after another. Whenever its messenger came unto a nation they denied him; so We caused them to follow one another (to disaster) and We made them bywords. A far removal for folk who believe not!
text.26:60: And they overtook them at sunrise.
text.28:42: And We made a curse to follow them in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be among the hateful.
text.37:10: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame.
text.77:17: Then caused the latter folk to follow after?
